api.itemIdentity: Runtime adapter reads the original item UID as canonical QWord decimal text and original prototype ID; neither is localized or modified.
api.exactGuards: A whitelisted eventID, original prototype base guard and the complete beforeEnglish -> afterEnglish transition must match. Custom or stale values fall back to current original English.
api.prefixReplay: Derive {{name}} from the existing validated chain, or an exact original prototype-name registry guard. Never translate by parsing a rendered name.
api.fixedReplay: Render the fixed semantic ID and reset the display base; retain complete original English transition records for later locale changes.
api.schematicReplay: eventID selects original assemblyRegistryId; validate afterEnglish = assemblyEnglish + ' schematics'; derive {{assembly}} through DRLRegistryText('mod_array', assemblyRegistryId, 'base_game', 'name', assemblyEnglish).
api.persistence: Separate versioned presentation sidecar; original Pascal item Name/save fields remain English. UID/prototype/base guards and whitelisted steps are mandatory on load.
api.failures: Unknown/custom event or guard rejection returns false without raising a gameplay error; source callers discard the result.
